name: Mahrem / Maḥrem (Aksum)

domain_history.domain: war god; Aksumite kings styled themselves "son of the invincible Mahrem" in their own inscriptions

notes: Attested via interpretatio graeca as "Ares" in the Monumentum Adulitanum and directly by name in Ezana's own pre-Christian Ge'ez inscriptions. Comparison to South Arabian war god Almaqah is repeatedly made in secondary literature but the degree of identity is explicitly uncertain — DISPUTED/LOW confidence, not settled equivalence.
